interface.title: CV Zebrafish (web prototype, issue #136)
interface.field: Behavioural neuroscience / animal pose tracking (zebrafish kinematics from DeepLabCut)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of pose-tracking output: turns tracked keypoints into per-frame movement measures, then review and export
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a DeepLabCut zebrafish tracking CSV (with an optional config JSON), compute fin angles, tail distance and head yaw for every frame, review them as a summary table, a frame-range plot and a full table, and download the enriched CSV.

data.note: Ran first with the 'Use the bundled sample file' button, which loads correct_format.csv with the default BaseConfig.json. Then uploaded correct_format.csv and BaseConfig.json myself. Both runs gave identical results: 5,351 frames and 60 result columns; mean left fin angle 17.4°, right fin angle 4.796°, tail distance -0.0001893, head yaw -136.5°. On the Mouse path the uploaded correct_format.csv only fills a read-only field labelled 'DeepLabCut File'.

tree.general: Turn tracked body-point positions from a video into per-frame movement measures, check them, and export them
tree.specific: Compute zebrafish fin angle, tail distance and head yaw from a DeepLabCut CSV and download the enriched results
